mutation.timeout_explanation: The constraint comparison loop index increment is reversed, so equal versions never terminate; counted as detected by Stryker, separately from assertion kills.

constraint_refactor.explanation: Numeric/wildcard parsing is performed once. Operators and comparator dispatch are exhaustive typed data. Empty-term, trim, optional-array and impossible-operator fallbacks are removed where prior validation made them redundant. Mutant counts therefore differ; the comparison does not claim every disappeared mutant was killed by a new test.
